items.label: Samsung Q2 FY2026 (07-30-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Memory Q2 results and Q3 outlook (Memory EVP Jaeju

set.signal: Memory Q2 results and Q3 outlook (Memory EVP Jaejune Kim): Q2 DRAM bit shipments rose by the low teens percentage QoQ, exceeding guidance; NAND bit shipments rose by a low-single-digit percentage, in line with guidance. Q2 ASP rose by mid 40% for DRAM and high 60% for NAND QoQ. Record-high bit shipments for both DRAM and NAND and an all-time-high server share of bit sales; memory set another quarterly record. Q3 outlook: with DRAM and NAND inventories significantly low, QoQ bit growth is expected in the mid-single digits for DRAM and high-single digits for NAND. CFO: the DS Division is anticipated to continue delivering growth in H2 on strong Agentic AI demand, with expanded sales of HBM4 including HBM4E, DDR5, SOCAMM2 and eSSD.

items.reason: Hedge restored: the CFO said the DS Division is anticipated to continue delivering growth; the entry stated it as fact.
items.evidence: For the DS Division, we anticipate the division will continue delivering growth, driven by strong demand stemming from the rapid spread of Agentic AI.

items.label: Samsung press release: Samsung and Mistral AI Announce Strategic Partnership for (09-09-2026)
items.signal_prefix: Supplier Mistral: Samsung entered a strategic part

set.signal: Supplier Mistral: Samsung entered a strategic partnership with Mistral AI under which it will integrate Mistral's AI services and solutions, including the Mistral Large model, across its semiconductor operations to build customized on-premises AI models; Samsung aims to apply targeted AI models to fab defect detection and equipment optimization to accelerate development cycles, manufacturing precision and yield stabilization across its advanced memory and logic chips.

items.reason: Skill section 2: ownership stakes / investment in another company are not captured; drop the Series D equity-stake sentence, keep the operating partnership.
items.evidence: Samsung has also led Mistral AI's Series D funding round, securing a strategic equity stake to support long-term technology collaboration.
